name: Shenzhou 24
location_str: Launch Area 91 (SLS-1 / 921) @ Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
destination_explanation: A satellite this low sweeps across the sky in a few minutes, so a ground station only gets a short window to talk to it on each pass.
slot_a_text: Shenzhou 24 will be the 24th flight of the Shenzhou program. The first astronaut from Pakistan is expected to fly on this on a short duration mission, with another Chinese astronaut to undergo a year long expedition.
slot_b_text: The Shenzhou program is a crewed spaceflight initiative by China. The program put the first Chinese citizen, Yang Liwei, into orbit on 15 October 2003.
